outputs.description: Per-alloy predicted endurance values used by the checker to recompute δ. Existence and schema are verified.
The computed δ values. The checker compares them to the paper's reported values (lower is better) and verifies relative trends (exponential δ < linear δ; SNIR δ within 2.0 of concentration δ).

output_contract.notes: The alloy composition data and SNIR parameters are provided inline in the Input Data section of the instruction (16 melts). The agent must fit the models and output the predictions and δ values.
